chunks.arabic_text: «مَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى بُقْعَةً فِي الْأَرْضِ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِنْهَا» وَأَوْمَأَ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى الْكَعْبَةِ «وَلَا أَكْرَمَ عَلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ مِنْهَا لَهَا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ الْأَشْهُرَ الْحُرُمَ فِي كِتَابِهِ

translations.en: "Allah, Blessed and Exalted, did not create any spot on the earth more beloved to Him than it"—and he gestured with his hand toward the Ka'bah—"and none is more honored before Allah, Mighty and Majestic, than it. For its sake Allah made the sacred months inviolable in His Book."
"the day He created the heavens and the earth."

en.summary: This hadith states the unique sanctity and honor of the Ka'bah as the most beloved spot on earth to Allah, Exalted is He. It also links the Ka'bah's sacred status to the sanctification of the sacred months mentioned in the Qur'an, highlighting its central place in hajj and divine worship.
en.seo_question: Why is the Ka'bah described as the most beloved place on earth to Allah?

key_terms.بُقْعَةً: a spot or place on the earth
key_terms.الْأَرْضِ: the earth, as the realm in which this place is distinguished
key_terms.الْكَعْبَةِ: the Ka'bah, the sacred House indicated in the report
key_terms.أَكْرَمَ: more honored or more noble in rank before Allah
key_terms.الْأَشْهُرَ الْحُرُمَ: the sacred months made inviolable by divine decree
key_terms.السَّمَاوَاتِ: the heavens, mentioned in the Qur'anic phrase of primordial creation
